about_the_game:
*Images are from an in-development game build.

The ultra-popular Japanese VTuber group hololive takes on the world of traditional Japanese card games in Holo's Hanafuda! In this demo, you will experience a healthy chunk of the complete game's Adventure Mode story, and have access to offline hanafuda gameplay and the bento box making features.

🎴What Is Hanafuda?🎴

Hanafuda, Japanese for "flower cards," are traditional Japanese playing cards beloved by people of all ages. For those unfamiliar with its rules, Holo's Hanafuda comes with a robust suite of helpful features that simplifies play with on-screen markers and tips, making it easy to enjoy an array of hanafuda-based games without memorizing card values and rules.

🎴A New Twist on Hanafuda🎴

In this demo, players will have access to both the core koi-koi ruleset and the holo awase rule variant—Holo's Hanafuda's brand-new twist on classic hanafuda gameplay. In the latter, use a deck of hanafuda cards featuring gorgeous hololive designs, then unleash powerful talent skills by matching cards that show the same hololiver in this koi-koi variant!

*Online gameplay and the oicho-kabu/flower awase game variants are only available in the complete game.

🎴Create and Share Handmade Bento Boxes🎴

Try your hand at designing fun, filling, and avant-garde bento boxes chock full of hololive love in the game's bento box creation mode.

*The complete game contains online features that allow players to exchange and share their bentos with others around the world.

🎴Characters🎴

😈Nakiri Ayame

“Greetings, Humans! Yoohoo!”

A kimono-clad Oni girl from the Underworld Academy. As she loves to prank people, she always uses will-o’-the-wisp on them just to have fun. Many may not realize it, but she is actually the president of the student council.

🌽Shirakami Fubuki

“Good foxy day! I'm Shirakami Fubuki!”

White-haired animal-eared otaku fox. She loves talking with people and will be happy if you give her the time of day.　

She aims to become a top otaku idol while enjoying each and every day.

🌲Ookami Mio

“Hellooowl! It is Ookami Mio!”

A black-haired wolf girl who appeared on our radar randomly. She often shows up around shrines. She likes gaming.

🌸Sakura Miko

“Nya-hello~! I'm Sakura Miko, an elite shrine maiden-idol!”

A shrine maiden from the Virtual Sakura Shrine. With a vivid admiration for idols, she constantly pushes herself to greater heights to become a top elite shrine maiden-idol like no other!

Well... a self-proclaimed 'elite,' to be exact. Fans would think "clutz" fits her better...

Keep an eye out for future DLC that adds even more hololive faces to Holo's Hanafuda!

🎴Story🎴

One otherwise normal day, hololive members Ayame, Fubuki, Mio, and Miko are suddenly drawn into a mysterious world full of hanafuda imagery. Soon, strange, shadowy figures appear to challenge the four to a series of high-stakes card battles that will decide the girls' fates! But hey, it's not all danger and darkness in hanafuda land—our heroines will also meet friends and allies along the way in this entirely original hololive hanafuda story!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel core i5-4690
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GT 740
  • Additional Notes: 1920x1080、30FPS
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11

short_description: Holo's Hanafuda is a banter-filled card game battler fully voiced by and featuring hololive talent! Join Nakiri Ayame, Shirakami Fubuki, Ookami Mio, and Sakura Miko on a wild adventure through a strange land filled with card games and chaos.
supported_languages:
English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese*, Korean, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Indonesian, Dutch, Portuguese - Brazil
*languages with full audio support
